data.key: Martyr ~ See No Evil Hear No Evil
data.name: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
data.description: The martyr and all allies within 20 feet of him gain a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against bardic performance, sonic effects, language-dependent effects, and gaze attacks. This ability functions only when the martyr is conscious.
